newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank of Boston Corp cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank of Boston Corp cut.

text.p: -- Brown Brothers Harriman said it cut its short-term rating on Bank of Boston Corp to hold from buy due to price.
-- Cut long-term rating to market perform from outperform.
-- Kept 1997 earnings estimate at $5.75 per share and 1998 estimate at $6.40 per share.

-- "A hold is truly a hold with this one -- we just can't keep telling people to buy the stock at this point," analyst Nancy Bush said in a research note. "Please do not misinterpret this move as a sell."
